text: Abakuru b'intara n'abayobozi b'uturere bashobora kugena, ahandi hantu hose hashobora gufungirwa ibinyabiziga kandi hakarindwa. Ubusanzwe ahagenewe gufungirwa ibinyabiziga ni za parikingi zemejwe na:
Buri modoka cyangwa buri Romoroki ikuruwe n'iyo modoka, ishobora kugira itara rituma umuyobozi yerekana ko yabonye icyifuzo cy'uwiteguye kumunyuraho; iryo tara rigomba kuba risa:
Ibyapa byo ku muhanda bigomba gushyirwa ku ruhande rw'iburyo bw'umuhanda, ku buryo umuzuzo wohasi udashobora kuba munsi ya m1,80 cyangwa hejuru ya m zingahe, uvuye ku butaka:
Iyo ubifitiye ububasha ashidikanya ku buremere bukubiye hamwe bw'ikinyabiziga, umuyobozi ategetswe kumuba hafi no kumufasha muri ibyo agomba kugenzura, bitagombye kurenza:
Ibintu bibonerana bigize igice cy'inyuma cy'ikinyabiziga, harimo ikirahuri gihagarika umuyaga cyangwa ibigize icyibambasi kimbere, bigomba kuba bikozwe kuburyo:

options.text: Iyo bimenetse bitabangamira bikabije uburyo bwo kugenda mu muhanda
Iyo bimenetse ibyago byo gukomereka byagabanuka uko bishoboka kose
Iyo bimenetse ibyago byo gukomereka byakwiyongera

text: Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga gikurikira ikindi, agomba gusiga umwanya uhagije hagati y'ikinyabiziga cye n'icyo akurikiye kugira ngo:

options.text: Abagenzi bamuhagaritse babashe kunyuranamo bibaye ngombwa
Atakigonga mu gihe kigabanyije umuvuduko ku buryo butunguranye
B na C ni byo bisubizo by'ukuri

text: Ntara narimwe cg akagarura rumuri bishobora kuba bifunze kuburyo, igice cyabyo cyo hasi cyanekimurika, kitaba munsi ya cm40 kuva kubutaka, ikinyabiziga kidapakiye. Ariko ibi bimaze kuvugwa ntibikurikizwa ku matara:

Ikinyabiziga cyanyuma mu binyabiziga biherekeranyijwe mu butumwa cyigomba gushyirwaho inyuma icyapa cy'umuhondo cyanditseho mu nyuguti zitukura "FIN DE CONVOI", aya magambo akaba agomba gusomeka no kumanywa muri:

Prokireri wa Repubulika ashobora gutumiza umuntu wese ufite uruhusa rwo gutwara ibinyabiziga akekwaho bumwe mu burwayi bwavuzwe, kugirango asuzumwe na muganga yamutegetse; muganga yohereza Prokireri ibyo yasuzumye mu gihe kitarengeje:

Feri yo guhagarara umwanya mu nini yaza romoroki, igomba gutuma romoroki iguma aho iri, uko yaba yikoreye kose; ku muzamuko cyangwa ku gacuri bya 16%, imyanya ya feri igomba gufata kandi igakomeza kwegerana kuburyo:

Ahatari mu nsisiro, umuyobozi wese ugenza ikinyabiziga kimwe cyangwa ibinyabiziga bikomatanye bifite uburemere ntarengwa bwemewe burenga 3500Kg cyangwa bifite uburebure burenga 10m, agomba, keretse iyo anyuze cyangwa agiye kunyura ikindi kinyabiziga, gusiga hagati y'ikinyabiziga cye n'icyo ari imbere umwanya uhagije kugira ngo:

options.text: Atakigonga mu gihe cyagabanyije umuvuduko ku buryo budasazwe
Atakigonga mu gihe gihagaze ku buryo butunguranye
Ibinyabiziga bimuhiseho bibashe kubyihutisha bidateje impanuka

text: Amatara kamera bihu y'inyuma ntashobora gukoreshwa keretse hari inkomyi zo kutabona neza (imiterere y'ikirere igize ko kubona neza bigoye, nk'igihu cyangwa imvura nyinshi bituma ntawe ubona hirya) ya:
Ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri n'ikinyabiziga gikururwa n'inyamaswa ntibishobora gukurura ibinyabiziga birenze:
Itara ry'guhagarara rifite ibara ritukura, rigomba kuba ridahumisha, kugaragara nijoro igihe ijuru rikeye muntera:
Iyo umuhanda ugabanyijemo ibisate bitatu kandi ukaba ugendwamo mu byerekezo byombi, umuyobozi wese abujijwe:

options.text: Kugenda mu bisate 2 biri ibumoso bw'umuhanda
Kugenda mu gisate 1 kiri iburyo bw'umuhanda keretse iyo tugana muri urwo ruhande byemewe
Kugenda mu gisate 1 kiri ibumoso bw'umuhanda keretse iyo tugana muri urwo ruhande byemewe

text: Iyo ikinyabiziga gikuruwe n'inyamaswa, na cyo na cyo kigakurura ikindi, uburebure bw'ibikururwa bukaba burenze m18 hatabariwemo icyo kinyabiziga cya mbere kiziritseho, hagomba umuherekeza:
Kuyindi ikanda yagenwe na minisitiri ushinzwe gutwara abantu n'ibintu, uburemere ntarengwa bwemewe kuri buri kinyabiziga cyangwa ibinyabiziga bikururana bishyizweho kuburyo bukurikira:
Umuyobozi ugenda mu muhanda mugihe ubugari bwawo budatuma anyuranaho ntankomyi ashobora kunyura:
Bitabujije ububasha abagenzacyaha bahabwa n'amategeko, abashinzwe kubahiriza iri teka cyane ni:

options.text: Abapolisi bose bo muri polisi y'igihugu
Ba ofisiye na ba suzofisiye bose bo mu ngabo z'igihugu
Abakozi bo mu biro bya minisitiri w'imirimo ya Leta babihereye ububasha na minisitiri w'ubutabera
Abakozi bo mu biro bya minisitiri wo gutwara abantu n'ibintu babihereye ububasha na minisitiri w'ubutabera
A,B,C na D byose ni ibisubizo by'ukuri

text: Ibinyamitende 3 cyangwa 4 bifite moteri: bivuga ibinyabiziga byibiziga 3 cyangwa 4, bitarengeje 400kg, kandi moteri ikaba itarengeje 350cm3, imbaraga zayo zikaba zitarengeje:
Niki umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga yakora  igihe agize uruhare mu mpanuka yo mu muhanda , aho ntawakometese  ariko ibinyabiziga bikaba  byateza icyago cyangwa byafunze umuhanda ?

options.text: Gushushanya aho  zagonganiye no kuzishyira kuruhande
Gukuramo abagenze ugashyiraho icyapa cya mpandeshatu girukura kumodoka
Gutegereza ko abapolisi bahagera mbere yo gukura ibinyabiziga mu muhanda
Guhagarika ibindi binyabiziga kugeza ikibazo gikemutse mukabona kubikura mu muhanda

text: Amatara ndangacyerekezo agomba kugaragara nijoro, igihe ijuru rikeye, mu ntera nibura ya:
Iyo ibinyabiziga bigomba kubisikana ari byo mu rwego rumwe, ugomba gusubira inyuma ni:

options.text: Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga gitwara imizigo ahuye n'igitwara abantu hamwe

text: Mu migi kimwe no ku mihanda y'igihugu, igenwa na minisitiri ushinzwe gutwara abantu n'ibintu, ubwikorezi ntarengwa bwemewe kuri buri mutambiko ufunze ibiziga 4 buzaba:
Amatara maremare, amatara magufi, amatara kamenabihu, amatara ndangambere, n'itara ribonesha icyapa kiranga ikinyabiziga, ashobora gukoreshwa gusa mu gihe:

options.text: Amatara ndanga ari ku mpera z'ikinyabiziga gikurura na yo yaka
Amatara ndanga ari ku mpera y'ikinyabiziga cya nyuma mu bikomatanye na yo yaka
A na B byombi ni ibisubizo by'ukuri

text: Utwaye ikinyabiziga mu muhanda ufite ibyerekezo bibiri .ikinyabiziga imbere yawe cyiragenda buhoro, imbere yawe umuhanda  nta kibazo kunyuranaho, ugomba :

options.text: kucyinyuraho ukoresheje uruhande  urwo arirwo rwose

text: Iyo kugenda mu muhanda bidashobora kunyuzwa mu yindi nzira, kugira ngo icyerekezo kimwe gishobore gukoreshwa mu buryo bworoshye, bishobora gushyirwaho:
